items.draft: Yenza ukuba irekhodi elilandelayo libe nexabiso
items.backtranslation: Make the next record have a price
items.problem: "Make the next entry count" (i.e. make it matter) rendered as "have a price/value" (ixabiso = price) - wrong idea in a money report.

items.key: Milestones use the selected observation cutoff. Assessment answers and action status remain current snapshots. Each measure shows its own coverage.
items.draft: Amanqanaba abalulekileyo asebenzisa umhla wokuvala okhethiweyo wokuqwalasela. Iimpendulo zovavanyo nemeko yezenzo ziba yimeko yangoku. Isilinganiso ngasinye sibonisa ubungakanani baso.
items.backtranslation: ...Assessment answers and action status become the current state. Each measure shows its size.
items.problem: "remain current snapshots" became "become the current state" (implies change); "shows its own coverage" became "shows its size" (coverage = who/what is included, not size).
items.corrected: Amanqanaba abalulekileyo asebenzisa umhla wokuvala okhethiweyo wokuqwalasela. Iimpendulo zovavanyo nemeko yezenzo zihlala zibonisa imeko yangoku. Isilinganiso ngasinye sibonisa ukuba sigubungela ntoni ngokwaso.
